Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Fold's Spaces empty state - two placeholder panels fill as two illustrated characters rise up into them from below, settle with a bob, and peek over their frames.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Fold app, light lavender-grey, Spaces tab active: two side-by-side rounded placeholder panels, "COMING SOON" chip, headline "Invite your family. See the full picture, together." with body copy, bottom bar with an invite pill and tab icons. The fills: a warm orange character and a dark-haired character in a yellow striped shirt, each half-height in their panel like portraits.

## Motion spec
Pattern: rising character fill for empty portrait slots.
- Panels idle as flat lavender placeholders with a faint inner shadow.
- The left character rises into its panel (translateY 60% -> 0, spring ~260/14, slight rotateZ -4 -> 0 degrees), followed by the right character 150ms later (same spring, opposite tilt).
- On landing, each does a tiny anticipation squash (scaleY 0.96 -> 1, 150ms) and then a slow idle bob (translateY +/-3px, 2.8s, the two characters phase-offset by half a cycle).
- Small accents (the orange character's head tuft, the yellow shirt's stripe sheen) shimmer once on settle (400ms).

## Calibration
- Characters overflow their panels slightly at the top - they peek out, giving the flat screen depth.
- The two never bob in sync; offset phases keep it alive.

## Reduced motion
Characters fade in seated (300ms), no bob.

## Don't miss
- The stagger is short (150ms) - a pair arriving together, not a queue.
- Panels keep their rounded masks; characters clip at the bottom edge, overflow only at the top.
